expectations.text: States that a specific engine baseline must be chosen per target OS version (mapping webOS/Tizen releases to their Chromium version) rather than targeting 'modern browsers'
expectations.evidence: explicit per-release table: webOS 4.x CR53 / 5 CR68 / 6 CR79; Tizen 6.0 M76 / 6.5 M85

expectations.text: Identifies concretely that optional chaining (?.) and nullish coalescing (??) are not supported on the older in-scope sets (e.g. webOS 4.x / Chromium 53, Tizen 6.0 / Chromium 76 and earlier) and that Array.prototype.at() / structuredClone() are newer still and will throw there
expectations.evidence: ?. and ?? need CR80 (breaks webOS<=6 / Tizen<=6.0); .at() CR92 / structuredClone CR98 throw

expectations.text: Recommends an actual transpile-down / correct Babel targets (noting the current { targets: { esmodules: true } } preset does not lower these features) plus feature-detection or polyfills for the newer APIs
expectations.evidence: esmodules:true does not lower these APIs; useBuiltIns usage + corejs3 + es-check
